scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n SERVER,CLIENT -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w @richesses-espace/server" "npm run dev -w @richesses-espace/client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @richesses-espace/client && npm run build -w @richesses-espace/server
scripts.build:static: cross-env VITE_LOCAL_GAME=true VITE_APP_BASE=/richesses-espace/ npm run build -w @richesses-espace/client
scripts.prepare:static: npm run build:static && npm run check:static
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @richesses-espace/game && npm run typecheck -w @richesses-espace/protocol && npm run typecheck -w @richesses-espace/server && npm run typecheck -w @richesses-espace/client
